tree.heading: Confer
tree.text: The term “confer” has the meaning given the term in section 1660d of this title.

children.text: the National Crime Information Center database;
the Next Generation Identification System; and

any other database relevant to responding to cases of missing or murdered Indians, including that under the Violent Criminal Apprehension Program and the National Missing and Unidentified Persons System.

tree.heading: Indian
tree.text: The term “Indian” means a member of an Indian Tribe.

tree.heading: Indian country
tree.text: The term “Indian country” has the meaning given the term in section 1151 of title 18.

tree.heading: Indian land
tree.text: The term “Indian land” means Indian lands, as defined in section 4302 of this title.

tree.heading: Indian Tribe
tree.text: The term “Indian Tribe” has the meaning given the term “Indian tribe” in section 5304 of this title.

tree.heading: Law enforcement agency
tree.text: The term “law enforcement agency” means a Tribal, Federal, State, or local law enforcement agency.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This chapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this Act”, meaning Pub. L. 116–165, Oct. 10, 2020, 134 Stat. 760, known as Savanna’s Act, which is classified principally to this chapter. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 5701 of this title and Tables.
